# The Mohul Makeup & Beauty Studio
# Bankura, West Bengal, India

> Premium skin consultancy, beauty therapy, salon services and makeup artistry in Bankura, West Bengal. Trusted by 500+ clients with a 4.9 Justdial rating and 8+ years of experience. Five core services: Skin Consultant, Beauty Therapist, Beauty Salon, Makeup Services, and Makeup Artists.

## Core Services (Priority Order)

1. **Skin Consultant** — Personalized skin analysis, concern mapping, custom routine plan. From Rs 800/session. https://www.themohulmakeup.in/skin-consultant.html
2. **Beauty Therapist** — Certified beauty therapy: facials, cleanups, de-tan, threading, waxing, skin rejuvenation. From Rs 500/session. https://www.themohulmakeup.in/beauty-therapist.html
3. **Beauty Salon** — Full-service salon at studio or doorstep: haircut, hairstyling, hair spa, mehendi, nail art, sari draping, jewellery setting. From Rs 300/service. https://www.themohulmakeup.in/beauty-salon.html
4. **Makeup Services** — HD & airbrush bridal, engagement, reception, and party makeup. 12+ hour durability in Indian weather. From Rs 2,500/look. https://www.themohulmakeup.in/makeup-services.html
5. **Makeup Artists** — Professional MUAs for weddings, photoshoots, fashion shows, on-location events across West Bengal. From Rs 1,500/artist/day. https://www.themohulmakeup.in/makeup-artists.html

## Booking Process

1. Inquiry (WhatsApp/call with date, event type, location)
2. Trial Session (Rs 1,500, adjustable in final booking)
3. Confirm Booking (50% advance to lock date)
4. Event Day (we arrive 30 min early, fully equipped)

## Payment & Refund

- 50% advance, 50% on event day
- Accepted: UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, cash
- Cancellation: 15+ days = 90% refund, 7-14 days = 50%, <7 days = no refund
- Reschedule free if 48 hours notice given
